body: This custom Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 170 AWD camper van is a testament to what’s possible in van life design. Built in the Olympus Tier, this van combines style, functionality, and off-grid capability in one stunning package. Its Energy Orange cabinets bring a bold and vibrant aesthetic, complemented by the warm tones of a stained wood ceiling and vinyl wood-style flooring. Perfectly crafted for inspiration, this van highlights how design and adventure go hand in hand.

Step inside to experience a thoughtfully designed interior that maximizes space and comfort. The kitchen boasts an acacia butcher block countertop, a stainless steel sink with hot and cold water, and a 700-watt microwave. Whether preparing a meal on the portable induction cooktop or grilling outside on the included 22” Blackstone Griddle, this van offers versatility for any culinary enthusiast. With plenty of storage, including five overhead cabinets and two floor-to-ceiling closets, everything has its place for life on the road.

Designed for both comfort and efficiency, this van features a memory foam full-size bed, a Lagun swivel table, and recessed LED lights. Climate control is covered with a diesel-powered Espar cabin heater, premium insulation, and a Nomadic X2 12V AC unit for year-round travel. Whether enjoying an off-grid escape or parked at a campground, the 400W solar system and 800Ah lithium battery ensure reliable power.

For outdoor adventure, the van includes a full suite of features like an Owl Vans Expedition Box, a bike carrier, and a side ladder to access the FVCO roof rack. The Nomadic electric awning with LED lighting provides a perfect spot to relax, while the bug net set keeps pests at bay. All-terrain wheels, side steps, and a Lost Saguaro tire carrier ensure the van is ready for rugged journeys.

While this particular build isn’t available for sale, it showcases the limitless customization options at Papago Vans. If you’re dreaming of your own adventure-ready camper van, let this design inspire your journey and start planning your ultimate escape today.
